design_changes: No client art (label PDF, packshot, prototype photo, logo/brand kit, unreleased names/claims) ever goes into any generator or editing cloud, pre- OR post-launch; generators get only Sol's generic prompts + a blank placeholder; label composited locally. Replaces O_LANCAMENTO.md D1 rule 1 'Post-launch... the product can go in directly' (breaks 'never trained', Higgsfield §4.2(a) warranty and Artlist's real-brands ban). Also bans Higgsfield brand-kit/product-id features on client assets.
PRÉVIA also composites locally: world with blank bottle generated, public packshot laid on offline (she has no right to feed another brand's packshot to a training service).

Settings/hygiene: no brand/product names or claims in prompts; Higgsfield Auto-publish OFF; Photoroom Data Control OFF or not used; Canva AI toggle OFF or Teams; Adobe Content Analytics opted out; CapCut never used; client files stay out of any chat assistant driving MCP.
Music: AI-generated (Artlist AI Starter, Firefly music or Lyria paid) instead of Artlist stock; never put Artlist stock into Higgsfield.
Keep C2PA/Content Credentials on export (Photoshop Content Credentials); disclose AI scenery to client; do not call deliverables 'fotos'.

Offer sheet wording: 'Sua arte nunca é enviada a nenhum gerador de imagem ou vídeo — nem antes, nem depois do lançamento. A IA cria só o cenário, com uma embalagem em branco; o seu rótulo é aplicado no nosso computador, a partir do seu arquivo. Por isso, por nosso intermédio, a sua arte nunca é usada para treinar IA.'

Offer sheet wording: 'Tudo o que entregamos é seu para usar, sem prazo e no mundo todo: site, redes, marketplaces, anúncios pagos, impressos e ponto de venda. Formalizamos isso num termo de cessão por escrito, junto com a nota fiscal, e não reutilizamos nem revendemos nada do seu projeto. A trilha do filme é criada para uso comercial e vai junto com o filme.'

Add a one-page written 'termo de cessão' (Lei 9.610 arts. 49-50) listing uses, worldwide, no term, non-reuse promise, AI-element and C2PA disclosure, free replacement on any rights claim, liability capped at order value.

Default stack: Higgsfield PLUS (worlds, generic inputs only) + Adobe Photography plan (Photoshop desktop, local composite) + Artlist AI Starter (music); 'sigilo total' option: Firefly Pro partner models or Google AI Studio with billing for world generation.
residual_risks: No self-serve tool gives IP indemnity (Higgsfield and Adobe: enterprise only); Sol carries third-party IP risk — cap liability contractually, avoid celebrity lookalikes and other brands' trade dress.

AI scenery may not be copyrightable in Brazil (Lei 9.610 art. 11/7) and outputs 'may not be unique' (Higgsfield §4.4, Google, Artlist, Canva, Luma) — exclusivity can only be Sol's own non-reuse promise. Court treatment of AI+human composites UNVERIFIED.

Provenance marks must be kept; platforms may label the client's posts 'AI info' (Meta confirmed for organic; ads UNVERIFIED). Whether a local re-export that drops metadata counts as 'removal' is untested — export with Content Credentials.
Higgsfield changes its terms (previous version had a perpetual irrevocable licence); anything already trained cannot be removed — re-read terms quarterly.
Label tracking on the moving bottle in the film requires a local desktop compositor; feasibility for Sol UNVERIFIED (separate hole).

CapCut Brazil/ROW terms, Canva individual default setting, Photoroom API training default, Artlist 'agency' classification and Brazilian BRL prices are UNVERIFIED — the stack avoids depending on any of them.
Soul ID or any real face requires a signed image release and consent (Higgsfield §4.2(b), §5.3); not in the default stack.
